tools.name: top_servers
tools.description: Ranked MCP servers from the latest MCP Morning snapshot. list=most_used (weekly downloads + GitHub stars/forks), rising (week-over-week download growth; requires 25 stars or 1,000 prior-week downloads), or new (repo created in the last 30 days). Optional language (GitHub primary language) and catego

tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search the MCP Morning snapshot by name, slug, GitHub repo, description or registry name. limit≤25, paginate with offset. Returns snapshot date and mcpmorning.com page URLs. Does not mean MCP Morning ran the server.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: One MCP server from the current snapshot: stars, weekly downloads, growth, install hints from registry package metadata, and links (GitHub, npm/PyPI, its MCP Morning page). Identify by slug, owner/repo, GitHub URL, or registry name. Install snippets are unverified — we do not run servers.

tools.name: latest_edition
tools.description: Today's MCP Morning newsletter: title, date, up to 5 featured items with links, and the archive URL. Snapshot date included. Editorial, not a test report.
